P01_COMMON_CANDIDATE.candidate_generation_rule: Same pinned candidate-generator implementation, initial candidate pool, source groups, proposal/search budget and seed schedule for eligible arms. Disabled-learning/adoption arms record that intervention instead of running useless training to consume a budget. Every proposal, rejection and evaluation opportunity is charged and retained.
P01_COMMON_CANDIDATE.requirement: Freeze the whole experiment family and each allowed variant before evaluation; one branch cannot supply compiler success while another supplies learning or recovery success.
P01_COMMON_CANDIDATE.runtime_rule: Bind request, durable owner job, exact stdout, fixed-path original files, candidate/image identity and independent review. Source snapshots or post-hoc consistency alone do not establish runtime execution.
P01_COMMON_CANDIDATE.variant_rule: All arms descend from the same frozen family manifest; only declared experimental factors may differ. Record each descendant manifest, parent, selected live identity and in-flight version; never imply variant manifests are byte-identical.

P02_GROUPED_INDEPENDENCE.current_fixture_use: Retain the controlled 4-action fixture as a conformance/retention sentinel. It cannot stand in for independent repositories or source groups.
P02_GROUPED_INDEPENDENCE.predicate: pairwise_disjoint(origin_groups[A], origin_groups[B], origin_groups[C], origin_groups[D_cold]); no near-duplicate or lineage group crosses a split; held-out oracles remain sealed until their phase
P02_GROUPED_INDEPENDENCE.requirement: Assign whole origin groups, including transformed near-duplicates, before generating split variants. Use temporal future groups for held-out drift when chronology is part of the claim.

split_roles.A: experience and training only; candidate generation may read these groups
split_roles.B: independent selection groups; all candidate queries count against a fixed selection budget
split_roles.C: new groups opened only after the Adopt or complete NoUpdate decision and live identity are frozen; never select or tune on C
split_roles.D_cold: further unopened groups after a fresh process/controller recovery; not a rerun of C or an equivalent template variant
split_roles.retention: sealed old-task groups plus the current eight-case deterministic 8/8 sentinel; no training or tuning on retained evaluation outcomes

P03_MATCHED_RESOURCES.budget_accounting: Equal predeclared ceilings and opportunities, plus measured actual consumption. Count retries, failed candidates, all action scoring, tool/model tokens or steps, background training, verifier trials and cold recovery. No free hidden search or refunded failed evaluations.
P03_MATCHED_RESOURCES.capacity_accounting: Count all reachable live parameters, all private/shared heads, optimizer state, active and shadow versions, retrieval state, activation memory and resident copies. Padding with unreachable parameters does not establish matched useful capacity. If no capacity match is possible, label the comparison descriptive and block the causal contribution claim.
P03_MATCHED_RESOURCES.capacity_or_compute_mismatch_policy: Do not call the comparison controlled. Either build an actually matched arm or publish it separately without attributing the difference to plasticity/topology.

P04_PREREGISTRATION_AND_STATISTICS.frozen_sentinel_predicate: The existing mature repair rule remains 8/8 on its sealed eight-case panel; do not remove it, reduce its observations, or weaken the current strict Adopt threshold.
P04_PREREGISTRATION_AND_STATISTICS.gain_predicate: lower_confidence_bound(paired_primary_metric_gain) > preregistered_minimum_meaningful_gain, with all retention/resource/authority gates satisfied
P04_PREREGISTRATION_AND_STATISTICS.missing_design_value_policy: Any required null blocks the experiment. These nulls are intentional missing commitments, not observed zeroes.
P04_PREREGISTRATION_AND_STATISTICS.statistical_unit: Independent source group; paired seeds/order blocks within groups. Repeated variants from one template are not independent observations.

P05_COMPLETE_COST_AND_FAILURE_ACCOUNTING.NoUpdate_rule: Report complete NoUpdate numerator, reason histogram and total eligible opportunities. Failed or incomplete trials remain failures, not completed NoUpdate.
P05_COMPLETE_COST_AND_FAILURE_ACCOUNTING.energy_rule: Use a calibrated, named measurement boundary and account for idle/background work consistently; CPU-only measurements cannot be relabeled whole-device/system energy. Unmeasured energy stays null and blocks a complete-cost dominance claim.
P05_COMPLETE_COST_AND_FAILURE_ACCOUNTING.memory_rule: Process-lifetime ru_maxrss and sampled RSS are labeled as such. Neither is called an exact concurrent campaign process-tree peak.
P05_COMPLETE_COST_AND_FAILURE_ACCOUNTING.no_double_counting: Inclusive/nested stage wall windows are not additive. Sum only disjoint measured resource intervals with explicit attribution. Record shared A/B diagnostics once; a component percentile is never a whole-task or whole-campaign percentile.
P05_COMPLETE_COST_AND_FAILURE_ACCOUNTING.tail_rule: An n=1 D-cold value is one observation. Compute p95/p99 only with explicit sample counts/estimator and meet a preregistered tail precision target before claiming tail improvement.
P05_COMPLETE_COST_AND_FAILURE_ACCOUNTING.whole_campaign_boundary: Frozen run start through training, all validation/search, build/compile, switching/migration, task execution and cold recovery; report initialization and one-time build cost separately and with a preregistered amortization horizon.
P05_COMPLETE_COST_AND_FAILURE_ACCOUNTING.whole_task_boundary: From accepted request/enqueue through queueing, inference, tool action, semantic check and durable final effect/readback. Preserve failures, cancellations, timeouts and unresolved results as separate outcomes.

P06_AUTHORITY_AND_RECOVERY.effect_oracle: A separately durable receiver-side effect ledger with request/effect IDs, owner epoch/fencing and commit receipts; the controller cannot prove external exactly-once effects from its own journal alone.

known_limits.cross_session_ablation_not_yet_qualified: The current no_memory fixture resets between observations; it does not implement the separately specified cross-session-experience ablation.
known_limits.current_controls_scope: frozen/no_learning intentionally identical; no_memory resets between observations; deterministic reads CPython diagnostics

current_task_contract.scope: controlled generated maintenance fixture, not general repository maintenance

known_limits.fairness_scope: same programs and nominal limits; PRED scores four actions, MEM one four-way head; actual work recorded, not matched compute

migration_scope.observed_kind: idle pure readout upgrade with same owner/partition/native transport/image and cold inference

observed_code_outcome.reason: complete build/energy/process-tree memory cost is not measured

known_limits.strict_gate_ceiling: The unchanged gate demands candidate B success strictly exceed every baseline; deterministic 8/8 makes qualifying adoption impossible on that same eight-case panel. This is a blocker, not a reason to weaken the baseline or gate.
known_limits.tail_scope: Phase/Cell component distributions and one D-cold task per Cell do not establish whole-task p95/p99 or stable tail improvements.

nonnegotiable_rules: Preserve deterministic 8/8 and the current strict admission/retention gates; never tune a baseline downward to manufacture Adopt.
Complete NoUpdate is valid process completion, not evidence of learned benefit; no adopted C/retention claim without live admitted-version receipts.
Do not drop failed candidates, incomplete runs, cancellation, UNKNOWN, lost acknowledgement or historical negative evidence.
Do not merge results across source HEADs, native images, runtime configurations, task manifests or independently generated candidate families.
Do not weaken the current in-flight migration refusal before an independently qualified handoff protocol exists.
Use changed independent information or a concrete unresolved gate to justify reruns; repeated runs of the same ceilinged four-action panel cannot establish new learning ability.

termination_semantics.ACCEPTED_CLAIM: Only the specific preregistered claim whose complete provenance, fairness, statistical, retention, cost and recovery gates pass.
termination_semantics.COMPLETE_NO_BENEFIT: All planned arms/opportunities finish with retained originals but the gain/adoption gate fails; publish negative results and complete NoUpdate reasons.
termination_semantics.FAILED_OR_INCOMPLETE: Missing originals, broken provenance, protocol failure, budget overrun or unresolved execution outside allowed UNKNOWN semantics.
termination_semantics.INCONCLUSIVE: Insufficient independent groups, unmatched capacity, inadequate tail precision, or other preregistered uncertainty.
termination_semantics.UNKNOWN_EFFECT: External outcome unresolved; keep custody and reconciliation requirements, never silently convert to no effect or resubmit.
